---
name: Bug report
about: Something in macdock behaves wrongly
labels: bug
---

**What happened, and what you expected instead**

**Your display setup**
How many displays, their resolutions, and their arrangement. A screenshot of
System Settings > Displays > Arrange is ideal: several macdock bugs turn out to
be arrangement-dependent.

**Dock settings**
Edge, alignment, icon size, magnification on or off. Or paste
`~/Library/Application Support/macdock/settings.json`.

**Permissions**
Is Accessibility granted?

**Version**
macdock version and your macOS version (`sw_vers`).
